Sundhedsklynge Midt is a healthcare cluster operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] [^src5]. It serves as a local organizational unit for monitoring and improving the quality of care for patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) in the Danish healthcare system, as detailed in the annual quality reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The cluster is significant for its clinical performance, notably meeting the national quality standard for Indicator 1, which assesses the timely initiation of anticoagulation treatment in newly diagnosed patients. In the 2024 reporting period, Sundhedsklynge Midt achieved a compliance rate of 91.9% for this indicator [^src1]. 

Beyond initial treatment, the cluster's performance is rigorously tracked across multiple clinical outcomes and processes. These include long-term anticoagulation treatment coverage at one and two years [^src2], as well as five years [^src3]. National geographic distributions map the incidence of stroke ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) across all healthcare clusters, placing Sundhedsklynge Midt within specific epidemiological intervals alongside other regional units like [[aarhusklyngen|Aarhusklyngen]], [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]], [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]], [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]], and [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]] [^src4]. 

Further quality metrics evaluated for the cluster include annual P-creatinine monitoring for patients on DOAC therapy [^src4], severe bleeding within one year of a new diagnosis [^src6], and heart failure within one year [^src6]. Additional analyses track overall mortality [^src7] and the implementation of structured patient education for newly diagnosed patients [^src9]. By stratifying data at the cluster level, the RKKP enables direct benchmarking and identifies local variations in clinical practice, supporting targeted quality improvement initiatives across [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and the broader national framework [^src11].
